snippet.title: Bonaparte: A Mechanized Revolution Turn-based Strategy & Political Simulation Game AVAILABLE NOW!
snippet.description:
A French Revolution simulation & political strategy game in which players can choose to defend, reform, or oppose the monarchy using a combination of tactical cunning, political influencer, and GIANT MECHS.

Bonaparte - A Mechanized Revolution is available now on PC!

“A visionary mix of Civilization, Crusader Kings, and… Armored Core.”
          - PCGamesN

"Yeah, I now firmly believe ‘Bonaparte - A Mechanized Revolution’ will be the grand strategy game to win me over."
           - VICE

1789, Paris. Take Napoleon’s place in an alternate history as Céline or César Bonaparte in this ideology driven, turn-based strategy journey. Defend, reform or oppose the monarchy and write your own alternative history by combining cunning political skills and tactical military prowess.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560340?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=AvailableNowtrailercut
